model: Mystique BACnet smart control station MYS-B (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Touch-Plate Mystique MYS-B 8-button BACnet MS/TP control stations; the 6-button Ultra ULT-B uses the same objects for buttons 1-6.
summary: The Mystique MYS-B is an 8-button wall control station that is its own BACnet MS/TP device. Each button shows up twice, as a toggling input and as a press/release input, and each button LED can be switched or given a color/flash mode from the BMS; the list shows the button 1 objects of each range. An Input Change Buffer object lets a front end catch presses without COV.
notes: Per-button objects are printed as ranges with a name pattern: BI 1-8 "Momentary0#", BI 101-108 "Maintained0#", AV 1-8 "Pilot0#" (# = button or LED 1-8), and BO 1-8 for the LEDs. Only the button/LED 1 object of each range is listed; add the button number for the others.
The manual prints no object name for the LED BOs; the table label "LED Controls" is used.
The Ultra ULT-B manual has the same table with 6 buttons (BI 1-6, BI 101-106, BO 1-6, AV 1-6) and the same AV 100 and AV 1001-1004.
There is no read/write column. Access is inferred from the object descriptions; AV 1-8 have a priority array.
LED mode codes (color, flash, intensity) are in the manual's appendix; intensity is shared by all LEDs.

integration.summary: Subscribe COV on the button inputs, or poll AV 1001 Input Change Buffer if the front end can't do COV. Use the maintained inputs (BI 101-108) for press-and-hold logic and the momentary ones (BI 1-8) for toggles. Drive the button LEDs from the BMS through BO 1-8 or AV 1-8 to show load status.

minimum_points.name: Momentary01
minimum_points.why: Button 1 toggle; BI 2-8 for the other buttons

minimum_points.name: Maintained01
minimum_points.why: Button 1 held = 1; BI 102-108 for the others

minimum_points.name: LED Controls
minimum_points.why: LED 1 on/off; BO 2-8 for the other LEDs

setup: Device instance is factory set in 68501-68999 (on a label) and can be changed through AV 1003.
MS/TP MAC address is set with DIP switches or AV 1004; baud 9600, 19200, 38400 or 76800 by DIP switch or AV 1002.
Changing the baud rate takes effect after a power cycle; changing the MAC address resets the unit.
The manual recommends 10 or fewer stations per MS/TP trunk and keeping lighting on its own trunk.
gotchas: COV subscriptions expire by default; write 1 to AV 100 to allow a lifetime of 0 (never expire).
Momentary inputs flip state on every press and start at 0 after power-up; they don't follow the button.
LED intensity is common to all LEDs: the last intensity written applies to every LED.

points.name: Momentary01
points.description: Button 1, toggles on each press (BI 1-8 = buttons 1-8)

points.name: LED Controls
points.description: LED 1 pilot on/off when not in Consensio mode (BO 1-8 = LEDs 1-8)

points.name: Pilot01
points.description: LED 1 mode: color, flash and intensity code (AV 1-8 = LEDs 1-8)

points.name: Baud Rate
points.description: MS/TP baud rate; applies after power cycle
